name: transportx-agent
description: TransportX Agent 本地交通分析桌面工作台
author: deflating

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run build:react && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:server: node scripts/patch-pi-resource-discovery.mjs && node scripts/generate-tool-contracts.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node scripts/postbuild-layout.mjs server && npm run build:tool-modules
scripts.build:react: node scripts/copy-cad-worker.mjs && node scripts/copy-pdf-runtime.mjs && vite build
scripts.desktop:dir: npm run build && node desktop/scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.desktop:pack: node desktop/scripts/check-desktop-release.mjs && npm run build && node desktop/scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml
scripts.desktop:dir:allow-unsigned: node desktop/scripts/check-desktop-release.mjs --allow-unsigned && npm run build && node desktop/scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/copy-cad-worker.mjs && node scripts/copy-pdf-runtime.mjs && vite --config vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:react && npm run typecheck:extensions && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run typecheck:test
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run test:budget && node --test --test-reporter=./scripts/test-budget-reporter.mjs test/suites/*.test.ts
scripts.test:core: npm run build && npm run test:budget && node --test --test-reporter=./scripts/test-budget-reporter.mjs test/suites/desktop-launch.test.ts test/suites/transportx-cli.test.ts
scripts.test:pi-smoke: npm run build:server && npm run test:budget && node scripts/pi-rpc-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:web: npm run build && npm run test:budget && node scripts/harness/workspace-conversation-smoke.mjs && node scripts/harness/workspace-upgrade-smoke.mjs && node scripts/harness/workspace-multi-host-smoke.mjs && node scripts/harness/workspace-blocked-smoke.mjs && node scripts/react-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:platform:macos: npm run build && npm run test:budget && node scripts/macos-desktop-smoke.mjs
